title: The user created a desktop file for the trash and moved a file or folder to the trash, but the trash desktop icon didn't change to the trash full icon.
line: A Trash link on the desktop of a new user now switches to the full bin when something is trashed, instead of staying empty until Plasma restarts.
explanation: Trash links on the desktop get their full or empty icon from ~/.config/trashrc, and the desktopnotifier kded module tells the desktop to refresh them when that file changes. It started watching trashrc when it loaded, but for a user who has never trashed anything the file doesn't exist yet, so the watch silently failed and was never retried: the link stayed the empty bin until plasmashell restarted. Now, while trashrc is missing, the module watches the config folder instead and switches to watching trashrc (and refreshes the links) as soon as it is created; it falls back the same way if trashrc is deleted later.

commits.message:
kioworkers/desktop: watch for trashrc being created

Trash links on the desktop update their icon when trashrc changes, but
watching it failed silently when the file didn't exist yet, as for a new
user who never trashed anything. Watch the config folder until it does.

BUG: 524339

media.caption: Pure master: junk.txt dragged onto the Trash link; it is in the trash (trashrc says Empty=false) but the icon is still the empty bin after 12 s
With the fix: after the same drag the Trash link shows the full bin
With the fix: emptying the trash goes back to the empty bin, a new file appears on the desktop, trashing it shows the full bin again
With the fix: trashrc deleted while running (empty bin), a file trashed (full bin), trash emptied (empty bin)

review.text: This cleanly fixes the exact root cause in DesktopNotifier: watching ~/.config/trashrc silently failed for new users who had not trashed anything yet because the file did not exist. Falling back to watching ConfigLocation only while trashrc is absent, switching to the file watch (and dropping the directory watch) once created, and handling later deletion is minimal, sound, and well-verified with screenshots, inotify checks, and passing testdesktop tests.
